name: roundhouse-lsp-client
description: Whole-app inferred types, nil-safety, and request traces for Rails, from the roundhouse analyzer.

roundhouse.serverPath.description: Path to the roundhouse binary (run as `roundhouse lsp`) or to roundhouse-lsp. Empty: use `roundhouse` on PATH, else the repo's target/release/roundhouse-lsp.

roundhouse.warnings.description: Also publish warning-level diagnostics (the analyzer's `gradual_untyped` / `unresolved_type` ledger — hundreds on a real app). Off: errors, syntax errors and N+1 findings only.
